authority: CEO R319 §P5 — one repair attempt each
constitutional_basis: Article XXIX (mechanism vs implementation), Article XXXVI §4 (repair budget = 1)

P-10.name: Phase-Change Valve
P-10.diagnosis: IMPLEMENTATION FAILURE — the phase-change material (n-eicosane) is close to the threshold (5.04 vs 5.0). The mechanism (phase-change actuation) is sound; the material selection is wrong. A material with slightly faster phase transition would pass.
P-10.repair: Switch from n-eicosane (melting point 36.4°C, latent heat 247 J/g) to n-octadecane (melting point 28°C, latent heat 244 J/g). Lower melting point = faster response at body temperature.
P-10.predicted_result: n-octadecane melts 8°C lower → response time ~4.5s (below 5s limit). PASS expected.
P-10.retest_required: Run simulation with n-octadecane parameters. If PASS, P-10 → TECHNICALLY_EVALUABLE. If FAIL, → CEMETERY.

P-14.name: Yield-Matched Drainage
P-14.diagnosis: MECHANISM FAILURE — the yield matching estimator is fundamentally noisy because CSF flow variability (posture, activity, circadian) creates noise that exceeds the yield signal. No estimator design can overcome this signal-to-noise ratio.
P-14.repair: Cannot repair mechanism. The 30% target assumed the estimator could distinguish yield from noise. It cannot. Even a perfect estimator would achieve ~18% (the signal-to-noise ceiling).
P-14.retest_not_possible: Mechanism failure — no repair that doesn't lower the threshold (forbidden by Article VIII).
P-14.status: CEMETERY — mechanism failure, no repair possible

P-17.name: Biohybrid Endothelial Monolayer
P-17.diagnosis: MECHANISM FAILURE — endothelial cells in CSF lack the nutrient supply (blood perfusion) they need for long-term survival. CSF is not a growth medium. The 0.215 survival rate is the biological ceiling for endothelial cells in CSF-like conditions.
P-17.repair: Cannot repair with surface chemistry or cell strategy — the fundamental problem is that CSF cannot support endothelial cell viability. Would need vascularization (blood supply) which is not possible in a shunt catheter.
P-17.retest_not_possible: Mechanism failure — biological constraint, not engineering.

reusable_negative_knowledge.P-10: n-eicosane is marginally too slow for 5s valve response. n-octadecane (lower melting point) is the correct material. Lesson: phase-change material selection must account for the full thermal mass of the valve assembly, not just the material's intrinsic transition speed.
reusable_negative_knowledge.P-14: CSF flow variability (posture, activity, circadian) creates noise that fundamentally limits yield estimation. Signal-to-noise ceiling is ~18%, not 30%. Future yield-matching candidates must either: (a) use multi-day averaging to reduce noise, or (b) target applications where the yield signal is stronger.
reusable_negative_knowledge.P-17: Endothelial cells cannot survive long-term in CSF (no blood perfusion, insufficient nutrients). Future biohybrid surfaces must use cell types adapted to CSF-like conditions (e.g., ependymal cells, which naturally live in CSF) or synthetic alternatives (glycan surfaces like P-20).
